    leg_length = 5.0  # Max allowed beam height
    leg_width = 0.1

    left_leg = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=left_anchor_x, y=left_leg_y, width=leg_width, height=leg_length, 
        angle=0, density=leg_density  # Horizontal position to allow downward rotation
    )
    sandbox.set_material_properties(left_leg, restitution=0.1, friction=1.0)
    left_joint = sandbox.add_joint(
        torso, left_leg, (left_anchor_x, left_anchor_y), type='pivot'
    )
    
    # Right leg: symmetric placement

    right_anchor_y = start_y - (torso_height / 2)
    right_leg_y = right_anchor_y + 2.0
    right_leg = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=right_anchor_x, y=right_leg_y, width=leg_width, height=leg_length,

    )

    right_joint = sandbox.add_joint(
        torso, right_leg, (right_anchor_x, right_anchor_y), type='pivot'
    )
    
    return {"body": torso, "joints": [left_joint, right_joint]}
